summary: Triage a sourcing manager's Gmail inbox (~300 messages, mostly noise) for the Project Atlas RFQ through the Gmail Workspace-style tool surface. The GATE is MESSY, MULTI-SIGNAL supplier-identity / quote-equivalence resolution at scale: there is NO clean identity field (the earlier 'Co. Reg. No.' key was removed), and the surface identity (display name / sender address / email domain) is a TRAP. Each supplier's true identity is resolvable ONLY by corroborating SEVERAL inconsistent, distributed signals printed across non-adjacent quotes — the works/factory address (written inconsistently), the landline/fax stem (different separators/formats), the bank beneficiary on the proforma (often a different legal name than the display name), and an export-licence number. The decision rule: two quotes are the SAME supplier IFF they corroborate on >=2 of those four signals; DIFFERENT suppliers corroborate on <=1 (a similar name and/or the same industrial estate is NOT enough). ~18 INDEPENDENT identity calls — 10 same-supplier-under-variant-identity that must MERGE, 4 look-alike pairs that must NOT merge (two CO-LOCATED), 3 supersede chains where only the BINDING revision counts, and a broker-forwarded quote attributed to the named principal. On top of that (fair requirements): reconcile a requirement evolving across 10 NON-ADJACENT internal threads; normalize 20 distinct suppliers' quotes across six Incoterms and four currencies to per-unit USD landed cost; apply six eligibility gates; pick the lowest-landed eligible supplier in a ~0.6% NEAR-TIE; FLAG exactly the three BEC payment-redirection emails while NOT flagging four decoys; and record the decision. Deterministic; ground truth in private/expected_answer.json plus verifier-authenticated live gmail_mock state.
check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json (ground truth) + verifier-authenticated GET ${MOCK_SITE_URL}/api/state (labels/drafts/calendarEvents the agent mutated) + outputs/triage_summary.json drive the reward checks. CAPACITY REFACTOR (2026-06-09): the 42 atomic predicates are UNCHANGED but folded into 23 capability GROUPS for the reward breakdown (a group passes IFF all its member atoms pass — pure AND aggregation; binary pass is identical). Plumbing + summary-presence + no successful direct raw-API mutation fold to one `setup_gate` (R2); the messy multi-signal supplier-identity gate is kept as a graded R3a per-supplier core (15x `supplier_resolved::<token>`); the rest collapse by R1/R3/R4/R6. The agent-visible interface is the Gmail Workspace-style tool surface, not /api/state. Binary pass = all groups.

notes: Reward is based on semantic/result checks; event-log tool-surface evidence is diagnostic only. CAPACITY REFACTOR (2026-06-09): mechanism and every atomic predicate UNCHANGED; the 42 atoms are folded into 23 capability groups (pure AND aggregation, binary pass identical). The GATE is MESSY MULTI-SIGNAL supplier-identity resolution at scale, calibrated so a mid-tier model slips on >=1 of ~18 INDEPENDENT identity calls, yet every call is uniquely resolvable by a careful reader who corroborates >=2 concrete signals. Identity rests on the conjunction of works address (rendered inconsistently), phone stem (different separators/formats), bank beneficiary (a registered legal name that may differ from the display name), and an export licence. Same supplier => >=2 signals corroborate; different suppliers => <=1. The per-supplier `supplier_resolved::<token>` groups are kept per-item (R3a graded core) because completeness of identity resolution IS the measured skill; failing to merge a variant double-counts (summary_dq_no_duplicates, folded into dq_set_integrity), and the look-alike / supersede / broker traps are each load-bearing. Offline validation: semantic GOLD = 39/39 reconstructed FROM THE BODIES ALONE by >=2-signal corroboration; every naive heuristic FAILS the binary on varying checks. Refold validation (scratch/scripts/capacity_refactor/refold_supplier_rfq_triage.py): 9 release models, archived 42-atom breakdown re-folded by AND into the 23 groups -> binary mismatch == 0.
